notes: Initial classification: data/feedback assertions must be mapped before physical removal; layout and old routes explicitly retired.
Four window/text profiles are not treated as data dimensions: replaced by four real authoring request profiles, without responsive claims.
The retired Ambiance stale-widget callback is a presentation binding, not a new guarantee that detached controllers reject edits. Map draft ownership remains independently tested.
Original keyboard/focus traversal assertions are retired with controls. Literal path submission semantics remain tested through ProjectSessionOpenController.
Neutral host rebuild/resize retains a real opened provider session without reloading; no product responsive acceptance is claimed.
Hub source changes preserve author-data/export/Player recipe intent; no Hub runtime pass is claimed before execution.

supportMigration.portability: No old Home/Session/Creation UI mounted. Fixture delegates creation, sessions, Workflow draft guards and export to canonical owners; real native MapEditingSurface remains.

nativeBatch1.reason: First native test teardown stalled at sessions.dispose awaiting fake-zone Future from real-zone runAsync. Exit0afterSIGINT is not a pass.

independentSourceReview.scope: Extracted picker/receipt opening branches and5workflow tests; callbacks do not claim Player acceptance.

limitations: Software widget tests prove real native surface/provider wiring and synthetic Player playback; no native GPU/device visual acceptance or performance claim.
